```{r}
#| label: packages-setup
#| context: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(shiny)
library(shinyWidgets)
library(plotly)
library(gt)
library(scales)

pitch_type_colors <- c(
  # Primary/common pitches — full green spectrum, most saturated
  "FF" = "#1B4332",  # four-seam fastball
  "SI" = "#2D6A4F",  # sinker
  "FC" = "#40916C",  # cutter
  "SL" = "#52B788",  # slider
  "ST" = "#74C69D",  # sweeper
  "CU" = "#95D5B2",  # curveball
  "KC" = "#B7E5C7",  # knuckle curve
  "CH" = "#40916C",  # changeup (reuse cutter's tone — rarely adjacent to it in practice)
  "FS" = "#2D9A4F",  # splitter (reuse sinker's tone)
  "SV" = "#95C2B2",  # slurve (reuse curveball's tone)

  # Rare/legacy pitch types — muted, out-of-family so they don't blend into a main color's meaning
  "KN" = "#8D99AE",  # knuckleball
  "FA" = "#8D99AE",  # generic fastball (legacy Statcast code)
  "SC" = "#ADB5BD",  # screwball
  "FO" = "#ADB5BD",  # forkball

  # Non-pitch events — grey, deliberately outside the color-coded pitch palette
  "IN" = "#CED4DA",  # intentional ball
  "PO" = "#CED4DA",  # pitchout
  "AB" = "#CED4DA",  # automatic ball (legacy)
  "CS" = "#CED4DA"   # (rare/legacy code)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| context: setup
# scrapped form savant and baseball reference
pitch_changes <- read.csv("pitch_changes.csv") |>
  mutate(FIP_diff = -FIP_diff)

player_year_data <- read.csv("player_year_data.csv")

max_pitch_change <- pitch_changes |>
  group_by(pitcher, player_name, team_from, team_to, year_from, year_to) |>
  slice_max(order_by = abs_change, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  rename(
    biggest_changed_pitch = pitch_type,
    biggest_prop_change = prop_change,
    biggest_abs_change = abs_change
  )
```

# Investigating Changing Pitches

## Filters {.sidebar}

```{r}
sliderInput(
  "cutoff_pct",
  "Major Change Cutoff Percentile:",
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  value = 95,
  step = 1,
  post = "%"
)

selectInput(
  "switched_teams",
  "Switched Teams?",
  choices = c("All", "Yes", "No"),
  selected = "All"
)

sliderInput(
  "year_range",
  "Starting Season Year:",
  min = min(pitch_changes$year_from),
  max = max(pitch_changes$year_from),
  value = c(
    min(pitch_changes$year_from),
    max(pitch_changes$year_from)
  ),
  step = 1,
  sep = ""
)

selectInput(
  "new_pitch",
  "Added a New Pitch?",
  choices = c("All", "Yes", "No")
)

sliderTextInput(
  inputId = "age_range",
  label = "Starting Season Age:",
  choices = seq(min(pitch_changes$age_from), max(pitch_changes$age_from), by = 2),
  selected = c(min(pitch_changes$age_from), max(pitch_changes$age_from)),
  grid = TRUE
)
```

## Main

```{r}
#| context: server

filtered_data <- reactive({
  data <- pitch_changes |>
    mutate(
      switched_teams = team_from != team_to,
      new_pitch_flag = pct_from < 0.01 & pct_to >= 0.03
    ) |>
    filter(
      between(age_to, input$age_range[1], input$age_range[2]),
      between(year_from, input$year_range[1], input$year_range[2])
    )

  if (input$switched_teams == "Yes") {
    data <- data |> filter(switched_teams)
  }

  if (input$switched_teams == "No") {
    data <- data |> filter(!switched_teams)
  }

  if (input$new_pitch == "Yes") {
    data <- data |> filter(new_pitch_flag)
  }

  if (input$new_pitch == "No") {
    data <- data |> filter(!new_pitch_flag)
  }

  data
})

cutoff <- reactive({
  quantile(
    filtered_data()$abs_change,
    probs = input$cutoff_pct / 100,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
})

filtered_cutoff_data <- reactive({
  filtered_data() |>
    mutate(
      cutoff_TF = abs_change >= cutoff()
    )
})

cutoff_pitcher_years <- reactive({
  filtered_cutoff_data() |>
    filter(cutoff_TF) |>
    distinct(
      pitcher,
      player_name,
      team_from,
      team_to,
      year_from,
      year_to
    )
})

cutoff_percent_changes <- reactive({
  filtered_data() |>
    semi_join(
      cutoff_pitcher_years(),
      by = c(
        "pitcher",
        "player_name",
        "team_from",
        "team_to",
        "year_from",
        "year_to"
      )
    ) |>
    select(
      pitcher,
      player_name,
      team_from,
      team_to,
      year_from,
      year_to,
      new_pitch,
      pitch_type,
      prop_change
    ) |>
    distinct() |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = pitch_type,
      values_from = prop_change,
      names_glue = "{pitch_type}_change",
      values_fill = 0
    ) |>
    arrange(player_name, year_from, year_to)
})



```

```{r}
output$unique_pitchers <- renderText({
  filtered_cutoff_data() |>
    filter(cutoff_TF) |>
    distinct(pitcher) |>
    nrow()
})

output$avg_fip <- renderText({
  filtered_cutoff_data() |>
    filter(cutoff_TF) |>
    group_by(pitcher, year_from, year_to) |>
    summarize(
      FIP_diff = first(FIP_diff),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    summarise(
      avg_fip = mean(FIP_diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
    pull(avg_fip) |>
    round(2)
})
```

### Graphs (Row 2) {height=65% layout="[1,1]" orientation="columns"}

#### Column 1

```{r}
#| context: server
cutoff_value <- reactive({
  req(input$cutoff_pct)
  quantile(
    filtered_data()$abs_change,
    probs = input$cutoff_pct / 100,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
})

density_data <- reactive({
  density(
    filtered_data()$abs_change,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) |>
    with(tibble(x = x, y = y)) |>
    mutate(
      fill_color = if_else(
        x >= cutoff_value(),
        "#52B788",
        "#B7E4C7"
      )
    )
})

output$density_chart <- renderPlot({
  req(input$cutoff_pct)

  density_data() |>
    ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_area(
      aes(fill = fill_color),
      alpha = 0.75
    ) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    geom_line(
      color = "grey23",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = cutoff_value(),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 1,
      color = "grey23"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "label",
  x = Inf,
  y = Inf,
  hjust = 1.05,
  vjust = 1.5,
  label = paste0(
        input$cutoff_pct, "% Cutoff = ",
        round(cutoff_value(), 3)
      ),
      size = 4
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Distribution of Year-to-Year Pitch Proportion Changes",
      subtitle = glue::glue(
        "<span style='color:#B7E4C7;'><b>typical pitch-mix changes</b></span>,
         <span style='color:#52B788;'><b>top {100 - input$cutoff_pct}% largest changes</b></span>"
      ),
      x = "Absolute Change in Pitch Usage Proportion",
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_light() +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown()
    )
})
```

# Individual Pitchers

## Filters {.sidebar}

```{r}
selectInput("lookup_year", "Year:", choices = NULL)
selectInput("lookup_team", "Team:", choices = NULL)
selectInput("lookup_player", "Player:", choices = NULL)

hr()

sliderInput("highlight_year", "Career Year:", min = 2015, max = 2025, value = 2015, step = 1, sep = "")
actionButton("play_btn", "▶ Play", class = "btn-theme-green")
```

```{r}
#| context: server

observe({
  years <- player_year_data |> distinct(year) |> arrange(desc(year)) |> pull(year)
  updateSelectInput(session, "lookup_year", choices = years)
})

observeEvent(input$lookup_year, {
  req(input$lookup_year)
  teams <- player_year_data |>
    filter(year == input$lookup_year) |>
    distinct(team) |>
    arrange(team) |>
    pull(team)

  current_team <- isolate(input$lookup_team)
  keep_team <- if (!is.null(current_team) && current_team %in% teams) current_team else ""

  updateSelectInput(session, "lookup_team",
    choices = c("All Teams" = "", teams),
    selected = keep_team)
})

observeEvent(list(input$lookup_year, input$lookup_team), {
  req(input$lookup_year)
  data <- player_year_data |> filter(year == input$lookup_year)
  if (!is.null(input$lookup_team) && input$lookup_team != "") {
    data <- data |> filter(team == input$lookup_team)
  }

  # Build disambiguated labels: name + all teams they've ever played for
  players <- data |> distinct(pitcher, player_name)

  player_teams <- player_year_data |>
    semi_join(players, by = "pitcher") |>
    distinct(pitcher, team) |>
    group_by(pitcher) |>
    summarise(teams = paste(sort(unique(team)), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop")

  players <- players |>
    left_join(player_teams, by = "pitcher") |>
    mutate(label = paste0(player_name, " (", teams, ")")) |>
    arrange(player_name)

  current_player <- isolate(input$lookup_player)
  keep_player <- if (!is.null(current_player) && current_player %in% players$pitcher) current_player else NULL

  updateSelectInput(session, "lookup_player",
    choices = setNames(players$pitcher, players$label),
    selected = keep_player)
})

selected_player <- reactiveVal(NULL)

observeEvent(input$lookup_player, {
  req(input$lookup_player)
  selected_player(list(pitcher = as.numeric(input$lookup_player), year = as.numeric(input$lookup_year)))
})

observeEvent(selected_player(), {
  req(selected_player())
  yrs <- player_year_data |>
    filter(pitcher == selected_player()$pitcher) |>
    distinct(year) |> pull(year) |> sort()

  updateSliderInput(session, "highlight_year",
    min = min(yrs), max = max(yrs), value = min(yrs))
})

playing <- reactiveVal(FALSE)

observeEvent(input$play_btn, {
  playing(!playing())
  updateActionButton(session, "play_btn", label = if (playing()) "⏸ Pause" else "▶ Play")
})

observe({
  req(playing())
  invalidateLater(4000)
  isolate({
    yrs <- player_year_data |>
      filter(pitcher == selected_player()$pitcher) |>
      distinct(year) |> pull(year) |> sort()

    current <- input$highlight_year
    next_idx <- which(yrs == current) + 1

    if (next_idx > length(yrs)) {
      playing(FALSE)
      updateActionButton(session, "play_btn", label = "▶ Play")
      updateSliderInput(session, "highlight_year", value = yrs[1])
    } else {
      updateSliderInput(session, "highlight_year", value = yrs[next_idx])
    }
  })
})
```

```{r}
#| context: server

output$pitch_mix_animated <- renderPlotly({
  req(selected_player(), input$highlight_year)

  pdata <- player_year_data |>
    filter(pitcher == selected_player()$pitcher)

  pitch_order <- pdata |>
    group_by(pitch_type) |>
    summarise(avg_pct = mean(pitch_pct, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    arrange(desc(avg_pct)) |>
    pull(pitch_type)

  bar_data <- pdata |>
    filter(year == input$highlight_year, pitch_pct >= 0.01) |>
    mutate(pitch_type = factor(pitch_type, levels = pitch_order))

  plot_ly(bar_data, x = ~pitch_type, y = ~pitch_pct,
          type = "bar", color = ~pitch_type,
          colors = pitch_type_colors) |>
    layout(
      xaxis = list(categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = pitch_order),
      yaxis = list(range = c(0, 1)),
      title = paste("Pitch Mix —", input$highlight_year),
      plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font = list(color = "#1B4332"),
      transition = list(duration = 500, easing = "cubic-in-out")
    ) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
})
```

#### FIP Change {width=25%}

```{r}
#| context: server

output$fip_change_box <- renderText({
  req(selected_player(), input$highlight_year)

  fip_data <- player_year_data |>
    filter(pitcher == selected_player()$pitcher) |>
    distinct(year, FIP) |>
    arrange(year)

  current_fip <- fip_data |> filter(year == input$highlight_year) |> pull(FIP)
  prior_fip <- fip_data |> filter(year == input$highlight_year - 1) |> pull(FIP)

  if (length(current_fip) == 0 || length(prior_fip) == 0) {
    return("N/A (no prior year data)")
  }

  change <- round(current_fip - prior_fip, 2)
  paste0(if (change < 0) "▼ " else "▲ ", abs(change))
})
```

## Main

### Summary (Row 1) {height=25% layout="[1,1]"}

```{r}
#| context: server

# Shared filtered base, respecting Team selection
lb_filtered <- reactive({
  req(input$lb_year)
  data <- pitch_changes |> filter(year_to == input$lb_year)
  if (!is.null(input$lb_team) && input$lb_team != "") {
    data <- data |> filter(team_to == input$lb_team)
  }
  data
})

output$lb_biggest_mix_change <- renderText({
  top_row <- max_pitch_change |>
    semi_join(lb_filtered(), by = c("pitcher", "year_from", "year_to")) |>
    slice_max(biggest_abs_change, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

  if (nrow(top_row) == 0) return("N/A")
  paste0(top_row$player_name, " — ", top_row$biggest_changed_pitch,
         " (", round(top_row$biggest_abs_change * 100, 1), "%)")
})

output$lb_biggest_fip_improvement <- renderText({
  top_row <- lb_filtered() |>
    distinct(pitcher, player_name, year_from, year_to, FIP_diff) |>
    filter(!is.na(FIP_diff)) |>
    slice_min(FIP_diff, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

  if (nrow(top_row) == 0) return("N/A")
  paste0(top_row$player_name, " (", round(top_row$FIP_diff, 2), ")")
})
```

### Row 2

```{r}
#| context: server

leaderboard_data <- reactive({
  req(input$lb_year, input$lb_rank_by)
  base <- lb_filtered()

  if (input$lb_rank_by == "overall") {
    max_pitch_change |>
      semi_join(base, by = c("pitcher", "year_from", "year_to")) |>
      transmute(
        player_name, team_to, biggest_changed_pitch,
        change = biggest_abs_change,
        FIP_diff
      ) |>
      arrange(desc(change))

  } else if (input$lb_rank_by == "fip_improve") {
    base |>
      distinct(player_name, team_to, year_from, year_to, FIP_diff) |>
      filter(!is.na(FIP_diff)) |>
      transmute(player_name, team_to, biggest_changed_pitch = NA_character_, change = FIP_diff, FIP_diff) |>
      arrange(FIP_diff)

  } else if (input$lb_rank_by == "fip_decline") {
    base |>
      distinct(player_name, team_to, year_from, year_to, FIP_diff) |>
      filter(!is.na(FIP_diff)) |>
      transmute(player_name, team_to, biggest_changed_pitch = NA_character_, change = FIP_diff, FIP_diff) |>
      arrange(desc(FIP_diff))

  } else {
    base |>
      filter(pitch_type == input$lb_rank_by) |>
      transmute(player_name, team_to, biggest_changed_pitch = pitch_type, change = abs_change, FIP_diff) |>
      arrange(desc(change))
  }
}) |>
  bindEvent(input$lb_year, input$lb_team, input$lb_rank_by)

output$leaderboard_table <- render_gt({
  req(leaderboard_data())

  n_show <- as.numeric(input$lb_show_n)
  tbl <- leaderboard_data() |> slice_head(n = n_show)

  is_fip_mode <- input$lb_rank_by %in% c("fip_improve", "fip_decline")

  tbl_gt <- tbl |>
    mutate(rank = row_number(), .before = 1) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(
      title = md("**Pitch Mix Leaderboard**"),
      subtitle = paste0("Season ending ", input$lb_year,
                         if (input$lb_team != "") paste0(" · ", input$lb_team) else "")
    ) |>
    cols_label(
      rank = "#",
      player_name = "Player",
      team_to = "Team",
      biggest_changed_pitch = "Pitch",
      change = if (is_fip_mode) "FIP Change" else "Change",
      FIP_diff = "FIP Change"
    )

  # Branch formatting/hiding based on mode, instead of conditional `rows =`
  if (is_fip_mode) {
    tbl_gt <- tbl_gt |>
      fmt_number(columns = FIP_diff, decimals = 2) |>
      cols_hide(columns = "biggest_changed_pitch") |>
      data_color(
        columns = FIP_diff,
        colors = col_numeric(
          palette = c("#1B4332", "white", "#B7E4C7"),
          domain = NULL
        )
      )
  } else {
    tbl_gt <- tbl_gt |>
      fmt_percent(columns = change, decimals = 1) |>
      fmt_number(columns = FIP_diff, decimals = 2) |>
      data_color(
        columns = change,
        colors = col_numeric(
          palette = c("#B7E4C7", "white", "#1B4332"),
          domain = NULL
        )
      ) |>
      data_color(
        columns = FIP_diff,
        colors = col_numeric(
          palette = c("#1B4332", "white", "#B7E4C7"),
          domain = NULL
        )
      )
  }

  tbl_gt |>
    tab_options(
      heading.background.color = "#2D6A4F",
      column_labels.background.color = "#B7E4C7",
      row.striping.background_color = "#EAF3E9",
      row.striping.include_table_body = TRUE,
      data_row.padding = px(10),
      heading.padding = px(10)
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_title(groups = "title")
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(color = "white"),
      locations = cells_title(groups = "subtitle")
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#1B4332"),
      locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_borders(sides = "bottom", color = "#40916C", weight = px(2)),
      locations = list(cells_column_labels(), cells_title(groups = "subtitle"))
    ) |>
    opt_row_striping()
})
```

```{r}
gt_output("leaderboard_table")
```
